integrity: General proof is analytic; exact-rational checker tests representative finite cases. Scientific correctness and originality have same-model review only. No independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: One-shot, independent Bernoulli strategic types. The independent benchmark deliberately discards realized-risk information; no general comparison with equally informed private signals, equilibria, policy impacts, or noise-varying group limits. Historical priority remains literature-bounded.
title: A Gaussian-width quorum reversal between shared-risk response and independent randomization
